in_marathi.name: Palomi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lotus in hand
in_marathi.long_meaning: Palomi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। She who holds the lotus in her hand. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'palā' meaning lotus and 'omi' meaning in hand.

in_bengali.name: Palomi
